question: Should maintainers refresh or adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/898, or close it and land an equivalent narrow fix in openclaw/openclaw?
rationale: The bug is clear, but an open linked fork PR already owns the GitHub closing path and is currently conflicting, so a new automated fix lane should wait for maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt or replace linked fix
options.body: Review the linked fork PR, then either refresh/adopt it or close it and land an equivalent narrow fix in the main repository.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and wait for the contributor to resolve conflicts and update proof.
